caption: The drawing features a single metallic tankard or mug centrally positioned within a square border. The tankard is cylindrical with a slightly flared top rim and a thick, rounded base consisting of two horizontal bands. The body of the mug is shaded to depict a smooth, reflective metallic surface, suggesting a pewter or silver material. A large, curved handle is attached to the right side, arching outward and finishing with a prominent curl at the base. The background within the bordered square is plain and unshaded, while the outer area of the paper is a light beige tone. Beneath the square border, there is a handwritten signature, “Charles Cullen,” in cursive. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, employing subtle shading and highlights to convey the three-dimensional form and reflective quality of the tankard.
title: Pewter Mug
